verified_source_anchors.description: GET /api/v1/lifemap/timeline endpoint delivering bitemporally filtered, reverse-chronological events with profile scoping and pagination.
GET /api/v1/lifemap/today endpoint producing the least-necessary read projection matching mobile LifeMapReadCache.project().
GET /api/v1/lifemap/v2/client-contract route returning safe state vocabulary (7 states), confirmed-only authority, and offline policy.
Optimistic concurrency guard enforcing If-Match header against current revision number (409 stale_version, 422 invalid_if_match).
POST /api/v1/lifemap/events/{event_id}/correct route generating successor revision and invalidating projection graph dependencies.
POST dispute and resolve truth transition commands with projection graph invalidation.
POST /api/v1/lifemap/v2/sources/{source_id}/revoke route invalidating dependent projections across all cited fact revisions.
Transitive projection dependency tracking and single-pass graph invalidation.
Precondition gate raising HTTP 428 Precondition Required when active medical disclaimer consent is ungranted or outdated.
GET /api/v1/mobile/summary endpoint returning role-based capabilities and server-authoritative LifeMap feature flags.
Client-side encrypted read projection cache verifying schema, TTL, and offline mutation blocking.
Mobile state vocabulary mapping and online-only capability enforcement.
